item_1.requested: Four-or-more-size F_p2 paired ecbench ladder, 2-torsion, Q-curve folding, double large primes, FourQ extrapolation
item_1.executed_diagnostic: Random short-Weierstrass F_p2 fixtures with a specified rational 2-torsion point; cofactor-projected x-in-F_p base, two-sum table oracle and counted negation-folded Pollard rho on the identical public known-answer target
item_1.curve_selection: First nonsingular seeded a,e with b=-e^3-ae and largest prime subgroup r>=p, cofactor even; at most 512 candidate curves
item_1.target: seeded k in [1,r), Q=kG; k is withheld from oracle and rho, used only to verify answers
item_1.rho: 16-entry r-adding random walk; a collision table indexes points modulo negation while the walk itself remains unfolded, avoiding canonical-walk two-cycles; <=32 restarts and <=100000 steps per restart. Collision-table entries are reported; this is not constant-memory Floyd rho.
not_discharged: full IC relation collection and extraction

item_14.requested: Genuine prime-field m>=4 constrained multivariate decomposition cost cells
item_14.factor_base: All curve points with integer abscissa 0<=x<B, B=ceil(p^(1/5)); both signs; prime-order curve selected by exact point count
item_14.solver: Ordered two-plus-two point MITM; every outcome compared with independent exhaustive ordered four-point enumeration
item_14.system: Full multivariate chained S3 presentation with x1,x2,x3,x4,u,v; include both finite intermediate and cancelling-pair exceptional branches; factor-base membership polynomial in every xi
item_14.certificate: Every hit includes the four actual curve points, independent sum verification, factor-base bounds and chained-S3 checks including exceptional-branch classification

accounting: Separate curve/subgroup construction, factor-base construction, table setup, target-online operations and verification. Count group-operation calls and finite-field multiplication/inversion calls; these remain separate units. No group/field conversion or speedup claim.
failures: Preserve construction failures, bounded rho failures, empty bases and zero natural yield. Reject any certificate or independent-oracle disagreement.
